description: Erection of single storey extensions to the existing club house, creation of an external courtyard and a mini golf course, alterations and the creation of a new bowling green, erection of a single storey timber food kiosk, erection of a 1.8 metre high metal fence to the southern boundary and installation of new entrance gates.
application_type_full: Full planning & demolition in a conservation area
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision.
Reason: In order to comply with Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990, as amended by Section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications: 100, 102, 103, 104, 105, 101, 106 Received 22 July 2026. Travel Plan and Management Plan and Hybrid Parking Survey and Transport Statement Received 20 October 2026

Reason: In order to ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission.

Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building, unless otherwise shown on the approved plans.
Reason: In order to safeguard the appearance of the area.

Condition : 4 - Customers shall only be permitted on the premises between the following hours: 09:00 to 22:00 Monday to Sunday, including Public and Bank Holidays. 
Reason: To protect the living conditions of neighbouring residents.

Condition : 5 - No live and/or amplified music or any other live and/or amplified noise shall be played in the external areas of the premises without the prior consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Reason: To prevent noise disturbance to nearby properties.

Condition : 6 - Prior to the first commencement of the hereby approved development, a Biodiversity Gain Plan shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority, the Plan shall include;
(a) information about the steps taken or to be taken to minimise the adverse effect of the development on the biodiversity of the onsite habitat and any other habitat,
(b) the pre-development biodiversity value of the onsite habitat,
(c) the post-development biodiversity value of the onsite habitat,
(d) any registered offsite biodiversity gain allocated to the development and the biodiversity value of that gain in relation to the development,
(e) any biodiversity credits purchased for the development, and
(f) such other matters as the Secretary of State may by regulations specify.
The development shall thereafter be carried out in accordance with the approved Plan prior to the first occupation of the development. Any habitats created or enhanced on-site and off-site in accordance with the Biodiversity Gain Plan must be maintained thereafter for a minimum of 30 years.
Reason. In the interests of improving Biodiversity and in accordance with The Town and Country Planning Act 1990, Section 90A, Schedule 7A.

Condition : 7 - A) Prior to the first commencement of the hereby approved development a Habitat Management and Monitoring Plan (HMMP) prepared in accordance with the approved Biodiversity Gain Plan shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The Plan shall include:
(i) a non-technical summary;
(ii) the roles and responsibilities of the people or organisation(s) delivering the HMMP
(iii) the planned habitat creation and enhancement works to create or improve habitat to achieve the biodiversity net gain in accordance with the approved Biodiversity Gain Plan;
(iv) the management measures to maintain habitat in accordance with the approved Biodiversity Gain Plan for a period of 30 years from the completion of development; and 
(v) the monitoring methodology and frequency in respect of the created or enhanced habitat to be submitted to the local planning authority. 

B) No occupation or use of the hereby approved development shall take place until:
(i) the habitat creation and enhancement works set out in the approved HMMP have been completed; and 
(ii) a completion report, evidencing the completed habitat enhancements, has been submitted to, and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. 
The created and/or enhanced habitat specified in the approved HMMP shall be managed and maintained in accordance with the approved HMMP.

C) Monitoring reports shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority in writing in accordance with the methodology and frequency specified in the approved HMMP.

Reason. In the interests of improving Biodiversity and in accordance with The Town and Country Planning Act 1990, Section 90A, Schedule 7A.

Condition : 8 - Prior to the use commencing, a management plan detailing how the approved site would be used, controlled and managed during day to day operation and events shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The operational management plan shall detail all events scheduled within the site and include details on how patrons will be managed whilst arriving and leaving the site. The development shall then be carried out in accordance with the approved details and retained thereafter.
Reason: To protect the amenity of neighbouring residents and highway safety.

Condition : 9 - a.	Before the development hereby permitted is first occupied or brought into use, a Travel Plan in accordance with current Council and TfL guidance comprising immediate, continuing and long-term measures to promote and encourage a reduction in car use shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The approved Travel Plan shall be implemented upon occupation and thereafter monitored and reviewed in accordance with the agreed Travel Plan targets and timescales to the satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority.
b.	Within 6 of the use commencing, a parking stress survey undertaken in accordance with the Lambeth Methodology shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.
c.	Following the findings of the parking stress survey, should any concerns and problems be identified, an updated Travel Plan shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. This Travel Plan shall be implemented and thereafter monitored and reviewed in accordance with the agreed Travel Plan targets and timescales to the satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority.
Reason: In order to support sustainable transport objectives, including a reduction in single occupancy car journeys and the increased use of public transport, walking and cycling.

Condition : 10 - Notwithstanding the submitted details and prior to occupation, full details (including manufacturer's specifications) of all cycle stands for the occupants of, and visitors to, the development shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The approved facilities shall be fully implemented and made available for use before any part of the development is first occupied and thereafter retained for use at all times without obstruction. 
Reason: In order to support sustainable transport objectives.

Condition : 11 - Before the development hereby permitted is first occupied or brought into use, a Delivery & Servicing Plan (including details of vehicle access and egress arrangements and times that servicing shall take place) shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The details shall accord with current guidance such as that issued by TfL and include measures required to ensure sufficient arrangements (physical as well as managerial) for the servicing, including refuse collection, of all aspects of the development, the timing of hours for deliveries by motor vehicles and a timetable for implementation. The development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with the approved details and shall be maintained for the lifetime of the development, unless the prior written approval of the local planning authority is obtained to any variation.
Reason: In the interests of the safety of pedestrians and vehicles, to protect neighbours' living conditions and to support sustainable transport objectives.

Condition : 12 - The trees that are specified on the drawings hereby approved to be retained shall be protected before commencement of any works on site and throughout the course of the development by methods that conform to the best practice guidance contained in British Standard BS5837: 2012 or any guidance that shall have superseded it

Reason: In order to ensure a satisfactory appearance of the site and the area and to promote biodiversity.

open_spaces_details.description: Extension to the bowling club. The open space is being replaced with a covered area designed to accommodate multiple functions. This space can remain fully open due to the inclusion of numerous bi-fold doors, providing flexibility in its use.
